ari_mean: arithmetic mean of the four dataset-level ARI means
nmi_mean: arithmetic mean of the four dataset-level NMI means
ari_std: compatibility field: arithmetic mean of dataset-level ARI SDs; not pooled SD, not a confidence interval, not used for inference
nmi_std: compatibility field: arithmetic mean of dataset-level NMI SDs; not pooled SD, not a confidence interval, not used for inference
